description: On-chain DEX data: search tokens and pools, prices, liquidity, OHLCV, and recent swaps across 36 networks.
limitations: Read-only market data. Each call uses the operator's DexPaprika credit quota. Finer candles and longer history need a paid plan. Not a trading venue.
setup_hint: Connect with a DexPaprika API key from https://console.dexpaprika.com. A free key is enough.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find tokens, pools, and DEXes by name, symbol, or address across every network. Call token or pool with a result's network and address.

tools.name: token
tools.description: One token's price, liquidity, and 24h volume. Pass DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base. and the token address.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

tools.name: prices
tools.description: Current USD prices for up to 10 token addresses on one network.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

tokens.description: Comma list of token addresses, at most 10.

tools.name: pool
tools.description: One liquidity pool: pair, DEX, price, liquidity, and 24h volume.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

tools.name: pools
tools.description: Liquidity pools on one network. Optional token, DEX, or creation window. Default sort is 24h volume.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

created_after.description: Creation window start: -24h, Unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD.

order_by.description: volume_usd_24h, volume_usd_7d, volume_usd_30d, liquidity_usd, txns_24h, price_usd, created_at. Default volume_usd_24h.

tools.name: ohlcv
tools.description: Pool candles. Default last 24 hours at 1h. A free key allows 10m and up over 7 days; 1m and 5m need a paid plan.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

end.description: Window end. Same formats as start.

tools.name: swaps
tools.description: Recent pool swaps, newest first. Optional from/to window, capped to the last 7 days.

network.description: DexPaprika network id, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

from.description: Inclusive start: -1h, Unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Exclusive end. Same formats as from.

cursor.description: Transaction id from a previous page.
